THE OUTCOMES

After 3 months you will FEEL...

F

FREE

Freedom from the constant need to control.

So many of us have been taught that our worth lives outside of us, which keeps us striving, gripping, and stuck in cycles of pressure and fear. In FEEL, you release this from your body. What replaces it is a deep, grounded sense of freedom rooted in trust, not control.

E

EMBODIED

To feel safe, connected, and at home in your body.

In a world full of noise and distraction, many of us have become disconnected from ourselves, using habits to avoid what we feel within — drinking, eating, scrolling, procrastinating, overworking. FEEL gives you the tools to meet and move emotion through your body instead of suppressing it. You begin to build a relationship with your body — a home you don't need to escape from.

E

EXPRESSIVE

Reclaiming your voice and your truth.

So much of what we hold in our bodies comes from what we've never said — the truths we've softened or silenced to feel accepted. FEEL helps you uncover who you are beneath the masks and gives you the space to express yourself honestly. You learn to communicate in a way that feels powerful, aligned, and true to you.

L

LOVED

Expanding your capacity to give and receive love.

Many of us abandon ourselves in the pursuit of love, leaving little room to truly receive it. FEEL guides you back to self-love first, creating safety within your own body.

WHAT IS FEEL

An Online Clinic for Your Inner
World

A space where women can heal from stress, anxiety and burnout
by learning how to connect with their inner world.

THE PHILOSOPHY

Transforming your inner world

In the world we live in today, we have been taught that the success, love, peace or happiness we crave comes from something on the outside — the career, the relationship, the finances….

So we work harder and harder, which creates further stress and disconnect from our bodies. FEEL flips all of this on its head.
Feel works on the philosophy that the happiness, success, wealth you are craving comes from shifting your world within. 
Because.. No matter what you do or achieve, you do it with your own body. And if that body is acting from a place of exhaustion, pain or stress … you will never truly feel what you desire no matter how hard you push. 
When we can deepen that love and connection to ourselves, everything in our outer world will come to reflect that.

OUR FOUNDATIONS

The Principles That Guide
Everything We Do

01

The Body as Home

We start with the radical premise that your body is not something to be fixed, disciplined or escaped from — it is the home you live in. All healing begins here.

02

The Inner World First

External circumstances change when we change our relationship to ourselves. FEEL works from the inside out, addressing the root rather than the symptom.

03

Evidence-Informed Tools

Shadow work, somatic practices, breathwork and inner child healing are all rooted in psychology and neuroscience — gentle methods with profound impact.

04

A Safe Container

Healing happens in relationship. Every space within FEEL — whether 1:1 or group — is held with care, confidentiality and deep compassion.

MY STORY

From Burnout to Inner Peace

The Early Years

I've always been a goer. From the moment I turned 18, I was off — moving, travelling, chasing experiences. I lived and worked in Ireland, America, France, India, the Gold Coast, Perth and Sydney.

The Pressure Underneath

From the outside, it looked incredible. But underneath it all, there was this constant pressure to keep going. Push harder. Do more. Nothing ever quite felt like enough. And rest was something I believed had to be earned.

The Moment Everything Stopped

Until my body stopped me. After multiple hospital visits, I had no choice but to stop. Completely. And during that time, something inside me started whispering... let it all go. Let it be enough. Let yourself rest.

The Turning Inward

That enforced stillness became the most transformative period of my life. I started studying — shadow work, somatic healing, breathwork, reiki. I began to understand that my nervous system had been in survival mode for years.

Where I Am Now

Where I am now feels very different. The best way I can describe it: no matter what happens out there — I've got me. I have my own peace. And that's something no job, no relationship, no situation can take away.

COMMON QUESTIONS

A Few Things You Might Be Wondering

How do I know if this is the right service for me?

 Let’s jump on a call together. We can do an emotional body scan and see where you are holding the most stress, pain etc. I can show you the platform and what it entails. You will know after. Trust your gut! 

Do I need any prior experience with inner work?

Not at all. FEEL will meet you exactly where you are. Whether that’s never having heard of any of this before or having done years of therapy which hasn’t quite got you to where you need to be. You will gain what you need from this journey regardless. Let’s jump on a call together!

Are sessions online or in person?

All 1:1 coaching and group sessions are done online so you can access them from anywhere in the world. I do run group sessions separately in Ireland which you will find on my instagram @roisin_katie or by joining my A SPACE To...community WhatsApp.

How much will this cost?

I have purposely taken a lot of time to discover how I can make my coaching as affordable as possible. It depends what programme, services you choose but you will need to budget approx €70.00 per week. Let’s jump on a call and I’ll explain all your options.

What should I expect from FEEL?

To go deep within. To go on an absolute journey. To be triggered and meet parts of yourself that you never realised existed. This is not positive mindset work, it’s not going to be all sunshine & rainbows. It will be emotional, heavy at times but my goodness will you access a new found level of inner con fi dence, clarity and connection that you could never begin to imagine. Let’s jump on a call.
